status: proposed allocations only; not a registry or normative authority

requirements.title: Scope and direct Contract identity
requirements.wording: Only ordinary unweighted supplied-p Holm for one selected all-pairs family of 3..120 members from 3..16 groups is admitted. The payload binds the exact Contract identity.

requirements.title: Supplied binary64 domain
requirements.wording: Inputs use exactly 16 lowercase hexadecimal binary64 bits in [0,1], including positive zero and excluding negative zero, infinities and NaNs. Sidedness is retained without changing p.

requirements.title: Exact adjusted target
requirements.wording: Decode on denominator 2^1074, sort by exact p then original position, form each rank product, take the cumulative maximum, clip at one, and restore original member order. Exact numerators use minimal lowercase hexadecimal.

requirements.title: Single binary64 projection
requirements.wording: Project the exact adjusted value once to nearest binary64, ties to even, and compare the complete display bit pattern with zero tolerance. No Record owns a tolerance.

requirements.title: Independent complete expected context
requirements.wording: The caller provides actual Record/revision identities, full declaration and selected inputs independently. Equality includes unrelated analyses before any private compatibility conversion. No authenticity is inferred.

requirements.title: Selected ownership and origin
requirements.wording: Selected analysis/family/result ownership and complete member order agree; source-hypothesis tuples are unique. Only the selected multiplicity-adjustment result is executed.

requirements.title: All-row arithmetic comparison
requirements.wording: Compare all exact adjusted numerators and all projected displays. Any mismatch prevents byte forwarding; display equality alone is insufficient.

requirements.title: Five ordered scoped checks
requirements.wording: Integrity, context, declaration, admission and arithmetic share the complete scope. A failed prerequisite gates later checks. Error has no pass/fail outcome; there is no aggregate status.

requirements.title: Complete refusal and resource mapping
requirements.wording: Each refusal has its versioned reason, kind and stage. Resource refusals have the matching limit category. Observed outer failure discards inner reports and forwarded bytes.

requirements.title: Canonical ingress and exact routing
requirements.wording: Strict UTF-8/JSON admission precedes exact bundle routing. Closed schema precedes canonical-storage admission. The original tagged byte projection and canonical value projection agree before digest acceptance.

requirements.title: Successor report and refusal structure
requirements.wording: Closed successor output schemas are used. Reports bind actual scope; refusals contain no Record reference or arithmetic result. Unknown input size is represented explicitly, never invented.

requirements.title: Conjunctive input bounds
requirements.wording: Record and expected byte caps, depth, nodes, string/key width, per-container bounds and inherited bridge limits apply together. Individual maxima are not a promise that simultaneous maxima fit.

requirements.title: No scientific or origin guarantee
requirements.wording: Every report leaves scientific validity, declaration truth, FWER and source authenticity not asserted; original p generation is outside scope. No alpha input or significance output is accepted.

requirements.title: Whole-invocation enforcement and cleanup
requirements.wording: Trusted execution retains all observed causes, fixed refusal precedence, unconditional descendant cleanup and no partial acceptance. Supervisor loss requires the external owner; no output never means acceptance.

requirements.title: Complete one-way declaration
requirements.wording: Retain the complete dataset, represented units, observations, groups, design, analyses, families and result slots with closed fields and valid D0 relationships.

requirements.title: Declaration shapes and compatibility
requirements.wording: The six closed operation_kind values identify declaration shapes, not executed scientific Contracts. Private one-to-one compatibility conversion occurs only after complete expected-context equality.
